accessKey.description: AWS access key. When provided along with the aws.secretKey, a Secret will be created and referenced in the external-dns Deployment.

secretKey.description: AWS secret key. When provided along with the aws.accessKey, a Secret will be created and referenced in the external-dns Deployment.

azure.description: Azure configuration. Package will create azure.json Secret, Volume, and VolumeMount with supplied values.

args.description: List of arguments passed via command-line to external-dns.  For more guidance on configuration options for your desired DNS provider, consult the ExternalDNS docs at https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/external-dns#running-externaldns.

env.description: List of environment variables to set in the external-dns container.

podLabels.description: Labels to be added to all deployment pods

resources.description: Configure CPU and memory requests/limits for the container

limits.description: Define the resources limits to overwrite the default values

requests.description: User input the resources requests to overwrite the default values

securityContext.description: SecurityContext defines the security options the external-dns container should be run with. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/

volumeMounts.description: Pod volumes to mount into the external-dns container's filesystem.

volumes.description: List of volumes that can be mounted by containers belonging to the external-dns pod. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/volumes

namespace.description: The namespace in which to deploy ExternalDNS

defaultLimits.description: User can input the defaultLimits values to overwrite the default

defaultRequests.description: User can input the defaultRequests values to overwrite the default

priorityClassName.description: The user defined priorityClass name of deployment pod

annotations.description: Annotations that can be set on the external-dns service account. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/annotations/

ca_crt.description: User input ca.crt to validate the DNS server connection, base64 code string required
